def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    row_sep = next((r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])), None)
    col_sep = next((c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == 2 for row in grid)), None)
    pts = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    if not pts:
        return out
    if row_sep is not None:
        top = min(r for r,c,v in pts); bottom = max(r for r,c,v in pts)
        if bottom < row_sep:
            dr = row_sep - 1 - bottom
            mark = top + dr - 1
        else:
            dr = row_sep + 1 - top
            mark = bottom + dr + 1
        for r,c,v in pts: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c,v in pts: out[r+dr][c] = v
        if 0 <= mark < h: out[mark] = [8]*w
    elif col_sep is not None:
        left=min(c for r,c,v in pts); right=max(c for r,c,v in pts)
        if right < col_sep:
            dc=col_sep-1-right
            mark=left+dc-1
        else:
            dc=col_sep+1-left
            mark=right+dc+1
        for r,c,v in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in pts: out[r][c+dc]=v
        if 0 <= mark < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][mark]=8
    return out
